title: the-device-roster-is-the-rack
intention: The device roster is the rack: a device is a folder directly under cairn/devices/, fronted by its shim, and the sleep roster is the rack devices whose device declares the `sleep` verb. A probes/ folder no longer makes anything a device.
why: Akien 2026-08-13: 'a DEVICE is a top level thingie. it's it's own process ... it goes in the rack.' Today the roster counts 42 devices including the tool drawer, so every surface that lists devices (the loop's record, the CLI, the sleep rotation) shows him things that are not devices.
traces_to: Law 6 and the complexity axis in CLAUDE.md (tools → machines → devices; `devices/<device>/<instance>/`), via Akien 2026-08-13 (the process test, 'it goes in the rack') and 2026-09-30 (bus charter: a DEVICE = its shim + its component(s)); ground loop charter item (3), 'reports the devices it finds'
how: Measured 2026-09-30: discovery.device_folders (the probes/ rule) yields 42 'devices', including tools such as base, question and artifact; cairn/devices/ holds 13 folders, 7 of which have a shim.py. AMENDED 2026-10-02 for RULE 1 (8e3474a6ae43): the roster is read by tools and devices alike, so it cannot live inside the cairn device's ground loop — bus_client (a tool) importing ground_loop.discovery is itself a RULE 1 row. A new tool cairn/tools/rack/ (charter born at the build, public_interface ['cairn.tools.rack.rack']) holds `rack(root)`: each cairn/devices/<d>/ with its shim path, or None where it has none. It reads only folder names and shim.py presence, never device code. The callers that mean 'which devices exist' move to it: deviceness.fitted_device_ids, bus_client's walk (bus_client.py:212, which then imports nothing from cairn.devices), efb670ff1dd8's DeviceRoster._fitted, and bin/probes/probescans_device_column_varies_with_the_world.py. The ground loop's beat record reports the rack (charter item 3). sleep_cycle token.roster(bus) becomes the rack devices whose announced menu — the latest record on the device's own announce channel, bus.read(to=<d>, channel='announce'), body.verbs, which every shim publishes at wiring from declared_verbs() — contains `sleep`. Nothing imports a device to ask what it answers. SLEEP_PROBE retires. A device that has announced no menu is off the rotation (it is not on the bus to hand a token to). A rack folder with no shim is reported by name as a device without a front, never dropped. AMENDED 2026-10-03 after efb670ff1dd8 PROVED (measured at cairn HEAD 5c257ede). (a) The callers of device_folders( outside discovery.py and the ground loop's proofs are exactly eight: bin/cmd/probescan:168 and :341, bin/probes/probescans_device_column_varies_with_the_world.py:79, cairn/devices/cairn/machines/sleep_cycle/token.py:65, cairn/tools/base/deviceness.py:76, cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_deviceness.py:122, cairn/tools/bus_client/bus_client.py:175 and cairn/tools/bus_client/roster.py:68 (efb's DeviceRoster._discovered; there is no _fitted). (b) bus_client.py:175 is _device_shim_module, the MAIL ADDRESS walk, not the roster: 83 probes post to='harbor_master', a machine the cairn device holds (6d667ccebfeb, Akien 2026-08-28) whose shim self-serves its mail. So rack.py publishes a second function, shim_of(name, root=None) -> Path | None: <root>/cairn/devices/<name>/shim.py if it is a file, else the one <root>/cairn/devices/<d>/machines/<name>/shim.py that is a file, else None — paths only, never device code. _device_shim_module and probescan's _find_shim_class resolve through it; the roster narrowing never cuts a delivery address (falsifier 8). (c) The liveness record carries no device list today (state keys: beats, started, recorded_mtimes, current_mtimes, changed, triggers); the runner adds 'devices': [ids of rack(class_root)] to every beat's state — Akien's own words for what the loop holds: 'THE PULSE, THE GROUND LOOP CONTROL FLAGS, AND THE DEVICES FOUND LIST'. (d) deviceness.py's two repo_root imports (lines 128, 142) take rack's repo_root instead, so tools/base imports nothing from ground_loop.discovery. (e) The proof is cairn/tools/rack/proofs/test_the_roster_is_the_rack.py, committed red at 5c257ede with one tooth per clause (1-3 share one scratch tree); the ground loop and sleep_cycle proofs named in builder_notes are re-pointed to the new signatures rather than given duplicate teeth.
falsifier: RED if after the build: (1) `rack()` returns any name that is not a folder directly under cairn/devices/; (2) it omits any such folder (proof: a scratch root with three device folders, one without shim.py, and a cairn/tools/x/probes/ folder); (3) a shimless folder is absent instead of listed with shim None; (4) grep for device_folders( outside discovery.py, its proofs and the pulse-site walk returns any caller; (5) token.roster(bus) names a device whose latest announced menu lacks `sleep`, or misses one whose menu has it (proof: a scratch bus with three announced menus, one carrying sleep, one not, one device silent); (6) the ground loop record's devices list differs from rack(); (7) the encapsulation sieve shows any row from cairn/tools/rack, or from bus_client or token.py onto cairn.devices for the roster. (8) mail to a nested machine stops resolving its own shim: rack.shim_of('harbor_master') is not cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/shim.py, or shim_of('trouble') is not cairn/devices/trouble/shim.py, or an unknown name is not None. WRONG INTENT if Akien names a nested device that must be on the roster. Horizon: the first live beat after the build commit lists 13 devices.
watchme: none, because the falsifier is read on every beat in the heartbeat's own record ~/.cairn/devices/cairn/0/machines/ground_loop/liveness.json (its devices list against `ls cairn/devices`), and a mismatch is the red, with nothing further to learn
dependencies: Build after efb670ff1dd8 (its DeviceRoster._fitted is repointed here).
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) What is rack()'s shape? `rack(root=None) -> list[tuple[str, Path, Path | None]]` in cairn/tools/rack/rack.py, sorted by name: (device_id, folder, shim_path_or_None), skipping names that start with '_' or '.' and __pycache__; root defaults to the repo root resolved from the module's own path. (2) Which callers move? deviceness.fitted_device_ids, bus_client.py:212, efb's roster._fitted, bin/probes/probescans_device_column_varies_with_the_world.py:79, sleep_cycle/token.py:65. The pulse-site walk (discovery.py:225) is deleted by 164da559823d, so leave it alone. (3) How is `sleep` read? From the bus, never by import: for each rack device, the newest record of bus.read(to=device_id, channel='announce') whose body has a 'verbs' list (the sleep cycle's own announce records carry no 'verbs' key — skip them); 'sleep' in body['verbs'] puts it on the roster. token.roster takes the bus the sleep cycle already holds; mint passes it. (4) Where do the proofs go? cairn/tools/rack/proofs/test_the_roster_is_the_rack.py for rack(), the grep, and the encapsulation rows; cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs gains the record-equals-rack tooth; cairn/devices/cairn/machines/sleep_cycle/proofs/test_token_rotation.py gains the announced-menu roster teeth. (5) Should the docstrings change? Yes: discovery.py's RETIRED paragraph and deviceness.py's module docstring are rewritten to state the rack rule, citing the 08-13 decision. (6) Fragile tooth: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_shim_starts_the_loop.py test_ground_loop_package_untouched runs git diff against HEAD on ground_loop/*.py and reds while a ground_loop edit is uncommitted; reseal it explicitly after the build commit.

decisions.text: cairn/tools/rack/rack.py publishes repo_root() (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]), rack(root=None) -> [(device_id, folder, shim_path|None)] sorted, one per folder directly under <root>/cairn/devices/ skipping __pycache__ and names starting '_' or '.', [] when the devices folder is absent; rack_ids(root=None) -> sorted ids; shim_of(name, root=None) -> <root>/cairn/devices/<name>/shim.py if a file, else the one <root>/cairn/devices/<d>/machines/<name>/shim.py over rack devices d that is a file, else None. Imports nothing but pathlib. Charter cairn/tools/rack/intention+why.json: runtime_role tool, public_interface ["cairn.tools.rack.rack"], proof proofs/test_the_roster_is_the_rack.py; plus __init__.py. shim_of returns the first nested match in rack (alpha) order; held machine names are unique today (measured 2026-10-03), and a top-level device always wins.

decisions.text: The bus API, measured at cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/bus.py:433: bus.read(*, to=None, channel=None, reply_to=None) -> list[dict] — every record addressed to 'to' on 'channel', flushed DB rows first then ring rows, insertion order preserved, so the LAST element is the newest. Each record is a dict with a 'body' key (a dict, or a JSON string after a DB round-trip — json.loads it when str). 'announce' is a declared channel; bus.post(sender=d, to=d, channel='announce', why=..., body={'verbs': [...]}) writes one, which is exactly what BaseShim._announce_menu (cairn/tools/base/shim.py) posts at wiring and what the proof's scratch bus (BusDevice.scratch) posts. So token.roster walks bus.read(to=d, channel='announce') in reverse, takes the first record whose body carries a list 'verbs', and includes d when 'sleep' is in it; records with no 'verbs' list (hands, closes) are skipped.
